title: Bitcoin ordinals and inscriptions drive on-chain activity su
content:
TL;DR: Bitcoin's block space is in high demand, driven by the sustained activity from Ordinals and Inscriptions, pushing transaction fees higher. This surge reinforces the network's security by increasing miner revenue, demonstrating Bitcoin's unparalleled utility as the foundational layer for all digital property. Transactors must adapt to these dynamic fee markets, prioritizing efficiency and understanding mempool conditions to safeguard their monetary sovereignty.
